risks: Silkworm flacherie and grasserie disease if hygiene is neglected
Thrips and tukra mealybug on leaves
benefits: Guaranteed Government Silk Cocoon e-auction markets with instant electronic bank transfer
Provides 5-6 incomes per year

name: Muskmelon / Cantaloupe (Kharbooja)
confidenceNote: Anantapur and Bellary premier sweet summer crop (Kundan / Madhuras / Arka Jeet).

images.author: (c) PRSonnen, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC), uploaded by PRSonnen

rainfallMm: Riverbed / drip irrigation with plastic mulch
spacing: 2 m x 0.5 m on plastic mulch with drip
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 40:25:35 kg N:P:K per acre (stop watering 4 days before picking).
harvestSigns: Half-slip stage (fruit detaches with slight pressure) and netting turns creamy white with intense aroma.
storageAdvice: Pack in ventilated cartons; holds 5-7 days at ambient temperature.
description: Muskmelon (Kharbooja/Kirini Pazham) is the sweet, fragrant superstar of summer farming. Ready in just 75 days, delivering rapid cash flow during the hottest months.
descriptionKn: ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯ ಕರಬೂಜ ಕೇವಲ 75 ದಿನದಲ್ಲೇ ಬಂದು, ನಗರಗಳ ಜ್ಯೂಸ್ ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಬೆಲೆ ಗಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: கிருணிப்பழம் கோடையில் தாகம் தணிக்கும் நறுமணமிக்க பழம். 75 நாட்களில் அதிக லாபம் தரும்.
descriptionTe: ఖర్బూజ వేసవిలో అత్యధిక డిమాండ్ ఉండే తీపి పండ్ల పంట. కేవలం 75 రోజుల్లో రైతుకు నగదు తెస్తుంది.
risks: Powdery and downy mildew in damp nights
Fruit cracking if heavily watered near maturity
benefits: Fast 75-day cash turnover
Extremely popular summer fresh juice and smoothie item in Indian cities

name: Mustard (Sasive / Kadugu)
confidenceNote: Indigenous seasoning black mustard and winter oilseed (Kranti / Pusa Bold).

images.author: (c) Shaun Swanepoel, some rights reserved (CC BY), uploaded by Shaun Swanepoel

rainfallMm: Residual soil moisture in winter black vertisols
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 4 tonnes + 30:15:15 kg N:P:K + Sulphur 15 kg/acre (essential for pungent allyl isothiocyanate).
harvestSigns: Pods turn golden yellow and seeds turn dark brown/black inside siliquae.
storageAdvice: Sun dry on threshing floor to 8% moisture; store in moisture-proof drums.
description: Black mustard (Sasive/Kadugu/Avalu) is the fundamental tempering seasoning in every South Indian kitchen. Requires minimal inputs and thrives in cool winter soils.
descriptionKn: ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಒಗ್ಗರಣೆಗೆ ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯವಾದ ಸಾಸಿವೆ, ಚಳಿಗಾಲದ ಕಪ್ಪು ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಖರ್ಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: கடுகு தாளிப்பிற்கு இன்றியமையாத பாரம்பரிய மசாலா-எண்ணெய் வித்து பயிர்.
descriptionTe: ఆవాలు ప్రతి తెలుగింటి పోపులో ప్రాణ సమానం. శీతాకాలంలో తక్కువ నీటితో పండే పంట.
risks: Mustard aphid (Lipaphis erysimi) during cold cloudy weather
White rust
benefits: Essential kitchen commodity with non-stop daily consumption
Low cost of cultivation

name: Niger Seed (Huchchellu / Uchellu)
confidenceNote: Indigenous tribal and rainfed minor oilseed of North Karnataka & Nilgiris (KBN 1 / Birsa Niger 2).

images.author: Silvestresbrasileiros

fertilizerSchedule: FYM 2 tonnes + 10:10:0 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Heads turn dark brown and leaves wither.
storageAdvice: Sun dry on clean tarpaulins; dry to 7% moisture.
description: Niger seed (Huchchellu/Valasalu) is North Karnataka's beloved chutney pudi oilseed. Grows effortlessly in degraded stony soils with zero fertilizers, adored by honeybees for its bright yellow nectar flowers.
descriptionKn: ಉತ್ತರ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಹುಚ್ಚೆಳ್ಳು ಚಟ್ನಿ ಪುಡಿಗೆ ಬಳಸುವ ಎಣ್ಣೆಕಾಳು. ಬಂಜರು ಮತ್ತು ಕಲ್ಲು ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲೂ ಸಲೀಸಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: பேயெள் வறண்ட மலைப்பகுதிகளில் மிகக் குறைந்த செலவில் விளையும் பாரம்பரிய எண்ணெய் வித்து.
descriptionTe: వలసలు ఉత్తర కర్ణాటక మరియు రాయలసీమ సరిహద్దుల్లో చట్నీ పొడులకు వాడే ఆరోగ్యకరమైన నూనెగింజ.
risks: Cuscuta parasitic weed in uncleaned seed lots
benefits: Thrives on degraded, rocky soils unsuitable for other crops
Exceptional forage plant for honeybees during autumn

name: Onion
confidenceNote: Bangalore Rose Onion (GI tagged export) and Bellary Big Onion benchmarks.

images.author: (c) Monteregina (Nicole), some rights reserved (CC BY-NC-SA)

seedRate: 3-4 kg/acre (direct seeds) or 400 kg bulbs/acre (shallots/small onion)
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 40:20:30 kg N:P:K + Sulphur 15 kg/acre (essential for pungency and storage).
harvestSigns: 50% of the plant tops (necks) bend and fall over.
storageAdvice: Field cure bulbs under shade for 5-7 days; store in well-ventilated bamboo onion storage structures.
description: Onion is an indispensable culinary staple. South India produces both big Bellary onions and high-value export shallots (Bangalore Rose Onion & Sambhar Vengayam).
descriptionKn: ಬೆಳ್ಳಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಗುಲಾಬಿ ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ (Rose Onion) ಜಾಗತಿಕ ರಫ್ತು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಖ್ಯಾತಿ ಗಳಿಸಿವೆ.
descriptionTa: சின்ன வெங்காயம் மற்றும் பெரிய வெங்காயம் தமிழ்நாட்டின் பொள்ளாச்சி, பெரம்பலூரில் மிக லாபகரமாக விளைகின்றன.
descriptionTe: ఉల్లి నిత్యావసర పంట. మార్కెట్ ధరలు పెరిగినప్పుడు రైతులకు ఊహించని భారీ లాభాలు తెస్తుంది.
risks: Purple blotch fungus during cloudy wet weather
Thrips causing silver leaf spotting
benefits: Bangalore Rose Onion has GI tag and 100% export demand to SE Asia
Excellent shelf life when properly cured with Sulphur

name: Paddy (Rice)
confidenceNote: Standard ICAR/UAS Bangalore package of practices for Cauvery and Krishna basins.

images.author: (c) Luis Mata, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC), uploaded by Luis Mata

fertilizerSchedule: Basal: 40 kg Urea, 100 kg SSP, 25 kg MOP; Top dress 25 kg Urea at active tillering and panicle initiation.
harvestSigns: 80-85% grains turn golden yellow and moisture drops to 20-22%.
storageAdvice: Sun dry on threshing floor until moisture drops to 12-14% before bagging in clean jute bags.
description: Paddy is South India's primary staple food crop, cultivated extensively in irrigated river basins and lowlands.
descriptionKn: ಭತ್ತವು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಭಾರತದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಆಹಾರ ಧಾನ್ಯ ಬೆಳೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಕಾಲುವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಳವೆಬಾವಿ ಆಶ್ರಿತ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇರಳವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: நெல் தென் இந்தியாவின் முதன்மை உணவு பயிராகும். ஆற்றுப்படுகைகள் மற்றும் பாசன வசதியுள்ள நிலங்களில் பெருமளவில் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது.
descriptionTe: వరి దక్షిణ భారతదేశంలో అతిముఖ్యమైన ప్రధాన ఆహార పంట. కాల్వలు మరియు బోరుబావుల కింద విస్తారంగా సాగవుతుంది.
risks: Stem borer caterpillar attack
Blast fungal disease under cloudy humid weather
Water shortage during flowering
benefits: Government MSP procurement support
Guaranteed local market liquidity
Paddy straw is high-value livestock fodder

stages.title: Nursery Raising & Puddling
stages.titleKn: ಸಸಿ ಮಡಿ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣ ಮತ್ತು ಗದ್ದೆ ಕೆಸರು ಮಾಡುವುದು
stages.description: Raise nursery with pre-germinated seeds. Puddle main field twice and incorporate 5 tonnes FYM.
stages.descriptionKn: ಮೊಳಕೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ ಬೀಜಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿತ್ತಿ ಸಸಿಮಡಿ ಬೆಳೆಸಿ. ಮುಖ್ಯ ಗದ್ದೆಯನ್ನು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಕೆಸರು ಮಾಡಿ ಹದಗೊಳಿಸಿ.
stages.descriptionTa: முளைகட்டிய விதைகளை நாற்றங்காலில் இடவும். முக்கிய வயலை இருமுறை சேற்றுழவு செய்யவும்.
stages.descriptionTe: మొలకెత్తిన విత్తనాలతో నారు పెంచండి. ప్రధాన పొలాన్ని రెండుసార్లు దమ్ము చేసి చదును చేయండి.
stages.importantTip: Apply Zinc Sulphate to prevent Khaira disease in zinc-deficient black and alluvial soils.
stages.importantTipKn: ಸತು ಕೊರತೆಯಿರುವ ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಖೈರಾ ರೋಗ ತಡೆಯಲು ಜಿಂಕ್ ಸಲ್ಫೇಟ್ ತಪ್ಪದೇ ಹಾಕಿ.
stages.importantTipTa: துத்தநாக பற்றாக்குறையை போக்க ஜிங்க் சல்பேட் இடவும்.
stages.importantTipTe: జింక్ లోపం నివారణకు ఎకరానికి 10 కిలోల జింక్ సల్ఫేట్ వేయండి.

tasks.title: Transplant 2-3 seedlings per hill at 3-4 cm depth
tasks.description: Maintain 2-3 cm standing water during first 10 days.

diseases.name: Paddy Blast (Pyricularia oryzae)
diseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions with ash-grey centers on leaves and neck rot of panicles.
diseases.symptomsKn: ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಣ್ಣಿನಾಕಾರದ ಬೂದು ಬಣ್ಣದ ಮಚ್ಚೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕುತ್ತಿಗೆ ಮುರಿತ.
diseases.symptomsTa: இலைகளில் கண் வடிவ புள்ளிகள் மற்றும் கதிர் கழுத்து அழுகல்.
diseases.symptomsTe: ఆకులపై కంటి ఆకారపు మచ్చలు మరియు వెన్ను మెడ విరుపు.
diseases.prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer. Seed treatment with Tricyclazole 2g/kg.
diseases.preventionKn: ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಯೂರಿಯಾ ಬಳಸಬೇಡಿ. ಟ್ರೈಸೈಕ್ಲಾಜೋಲ್‌ನಿಂದ ಬೀಜೋಪಚಾರ ಮಾಡಿ.
diseases.preventionTa: அதிக தழைச்சத்து இடுவதை தவிர்க்கவும். ட்ரைசைக்ளசோல் கொண்டு விதை நேர்த்தி செய்யவும்.
diseases.preventionTe: యూరియా మోతాదు తగ్గించండి. ట్రైసైక్లజోల్‌తో విత్తన శుద్ధి చేయండి.
diseases.organicRemedy: Spray 10% Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/Litre water at 15-day intervals.
diseases.chemicalRemedy: Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6g/Litre water when initial spots appear.

name: Palak / Indian Spinach
confidenceNote: Multi-cut high-iron leafy green (All Green / Pusa Harit).

images.author: Rasbak

durationDays: Multi-cut (first cut at 30 days, then every 15-20 days)
harvestMonths: 30 days from sowing, then every 2 weeks (3-4 cuts total)
spacing: 20 cm x 5 cm in flat beds
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 25:15:15 kg N:P:K per acre (top dress 15 kg Urea after each cut).
harvestSigns: Tender dark green leaves reach 15-20 cm length.
storageAdvice: Wash lightly, bundle with banana fibre; market on the morning of harvest.
description: Palak (Spinach) is the #1 household leafy green vegetable. Yielding 3-4 cuttings from a single sowing, it provides guaranteed weekly cash for farmers near towns.
descriptionKn: ಪಾಲಕ್ ಸೊಪ್ಪು ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಬಿತ್ತಿದರೆ 3-4 ಬಾರಿ ಕಟಾವು ಕೊಡುವ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಕಬ್ಬಿಣಾಂಶವುಳ್ಳ ಸೊಪ್ಪು.
descriptionTa: பசலைக்கீரை இரும்புச்சத்து நிறைந்தது. ஒரே நடவில் 3 முறை அறுவடை தரும் எளிய பயிர்.
descriptionTe: పాలకూర రక్తాన్ని వృద్ధి చేసే ఐరన్ గని. ఒకసారి విత్తితే 3-4 కోతలు వస్తాయి.
risks: Cercospora leaf spot in warm humid weather
benefits: Multi-cut capability (3-4 harvests from single sowing)
Constant year-round household and restaurant demand

name: Papaya (Taiwan Red Lady 786)
confidenceNote: Red Lady 786 gynodioecious hybrid benchmark for commercial orchards.

images.author: Franz Eugen Köhler, Köhler's Medizinal-Pflanzen

harvestMonths: Starts 8-9 months after planting and continues for 15 months
rainfallMm: 600-900 mm (roots rot instantly in waterlogged soil)
spacing: 2 m x 2 m or 1.8 m x 1.8 m
fertilizerSchedule: 10 kg FYM + 200g N, 200g P, 250g K per plant applied in 6 splits.
harvestSigns: Slight yellowing or orange streaks appear at apex of green fruit.
storageAdvice: Harvest with hand twist; wrap individually in foam nets; ripens at room temperature.
intercroppingOptions: Short pulses (green gram/cowpea) during first 3 months only
description: Papaya (Red Lady 786) starts bearing in just 8-9 months and yields up to 40 tonnes per acre. It gives one of the highest returns per acre among all fruit crops.
descriptionKn: ರೆಡ್ ಲೇಡಿ 786 ಪಪ್ಪಾಯಿ ಕೇವಲ 8 ತಿಂಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಫಸಲು ಆರಂಭಿಸಿ, ಎಕರೆಗೆ 40 ಟನ್ ಇಳುವರಿ ನೀಡುವ ಹಣದ ಮಳೆ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: ரெட் லேடி பப்பாளி 8 மாதங்களில் காய்க்க தொடங்கும். குறுகிய காலத்தில் அதிக லாபம் ஈட்டும் அற்புதம்.
descriptionTe: రెడ్ లేడీ 786 బొప్పాయి నాటిన 8 నెలలకే కాపునిస్తుంది. అతి తక్కువ కాలంలో లక్షల రాబడి ఇచ్చే పంట.
risks: Papaya Ring Spot Virus (PRSV) transmitted by aphids
Foot rot / damping off in ill-drained soils
benefits: Fastest commercial fruiting (harvest in 8-9 months)
Huge tonnage (50-70 kg per tree)

name: Passion Fruit (Purple / Yellow)
confidenceNote: Coorg and Nilgiris high-elevation trellis vine benchmark (KAU Kavery / Purple Gold).

images.author: Unknown authorUnknown author

durationDays: Perennial vine on wire trellis (5-7 years)
seasons: Harvest: May - June and September - November (two flushes)
harvestMonths: May to June and September to November
fertilizerSchedule: 10 kg compost + 100g N, 50g P, 100g K per vine/year in 2 splits.
harvestSigns: Fruits turn deep purple or golden yellow and drop to ground or detach easily.
storageAdvice: Pack in crates; shriveled skin indicates maximum sugar sweetness and juice content.
intercroppingOptions: Ideal fence crop and shade trellis crop in coffee/areca estates
description: Passion fruit is an aromatic, high-juice subtropical vine yielding heavy crops on perimeter fences and wire trellises in Coorg, Hassan, and the Nilgiris.
descriptionKn: ಕೊಡಗು ಮತ್ತು ಹಾಸನದಲ್ಲಿ ತಂತಿ ಬೇಲಿಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಪ್ಯಾಶನ್ ಹಣ್ಣು, ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಸುವಾಸನೆಯ ಜ್ಯೂಸ್ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: கொடி தோடை அதிக வைட்டமின் சி மற்றும் நறுமணம் கொண்ட பிரீமியம் ஜூஸ் பழப்பயிர்.
descriptionTe: ప్యాషన్ ఫ్రూట్ సువాసనభరితమైన జ్యూస్‌లకు అత్యంత ప్రసిద్ధి. కంచె పంటగా కూడా సాగు చేయవచ్చు.
risks: Brown spot (Alternaria passiflorae) in wet monsoons
Fruit fly
benefits: Begins bearing in under 12 months
Turns farm boundary fences into high-earning juice fruit production lines

name: Pearl Millet (Bajra)
confidenceNote: Package of practices verified for arid and semi-arid tracts.

images.author: no rights reserved, uploaded by 葉子

fertilizerSchedule: 25:12:12 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Earheads turn greyish-brown and seeds become dry and firm.
storageAdvice: Dry to 10% moisture content in gunny bags.
description: Pearl millet (Kambu/Sajje) is the most drought and heat-tolerant cereal on earth, thriving in light sandy soils.
descriptionKn: ಸಜ್ಜೆಯು ತೀವ್ರ ಉಷ್ಣಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಬರವನ್ನು ತಡೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಬೆಳೆ. ದೇಹಕ್ಕೆ ತಂಪು ನೀಡುವ ಪೌಷ್ಟಿಕ ಆಹಾರ.
descriptionTa: கம்பு கடுமையான வறட்சியையும் வெப்பத்தையும் தாங்கி வளரும் உடலுக்கு குளிர்ச்சி தரும் சிறுதானியம்.
descriptionTe: సజ్జలు ఎండను తట్టుకుని తక్కువ నీటితో అతి తక్కువ రోజుల్లో చేతికొచ్చే బలవర్థకమైన చిరుధాన్యం.
risks: Downy mildew in humid pockets
Ergot disease during rainy flowering
benefits: Extremely short duration (80 days)
Highest iron and zinc content among cereals

name: Pineapple (Kew / Queen)
confidenceNote: Vazhakulam (GI Pineapple capital of Kerala) & Coastal Karnataka benchmarks (Mauritius / Kew).

images.author: (c) Diogo Luiz, some rights reserved (CC BY), uploaded by Diogo Luiz

seedRate: 18,000-22,000 suckers/slips per acre (paired row system: 60x30 cm)
spacing: 60 cm x 30 cm in paired rows with 90 cm trench
fertilizerSchedule: 10 tonnes compost + 80:40:80 kg N:P:K per acre (spray 25 ppm Ethephon at 10 months for 100% uniform flowering).
harvestSigns: Eye scales turn golden yellow from base upward; fruit emits characteristic tropical aroma.
storageAdvice: Pack in crates with straw; stores 2-3 weeks at 10-12°C.
intercroppingOptions: Intercrop inside young rubber, coconut, and arecanut plantations
description: Pineapple (Vazhakulam GI) is the premier fruit intercrop in young coconut, arecanut, and rubber estates. Chemical flower induction guarantees planned harvests for peak market pricing.
descriptionKn: ತೆಂಗು ಮತ್ತು ಅಡಿಕೆ ತೋಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಿಶ್ರಬೆಳೆಯಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಅನಾನಸ್, ಎಕರೆಗೆ 25 ಟನ್ ಫಸಲು ನೀಡುವ ಲಾಭದಾಯಕ ಹಣ್ಣು.
descriptionTa: வாழை, தென்னை தோப்புகளில் ஊடுபயிராக பயிரிடப்படும் அன்னாசி அதிக ஏற்றுமதி மதிப்பு கொண்டது.
descriptionTe: కొబ్బరి తోటల్లో అంతరపంటగా అనాస సాగు చేసి రైతులు ఎకరానికి రూ. 3 నుంచి 4 లక్షల నికర లాಭం పొందుతున్నారు.
risks: Heart rot / root rot (Phytophthora) in waterlogged soils
Mealybug wilt
benefits: Perfect companion inside young rubber and coconut estates
Uniform flowering and harvest with Ethephon

name: Pomegranate (Bhagawa)
confidenceNote: Chitradurga, Bagalkot and Anantapur Bhagawa export orchard benchmarks.

images.author: (c) H. Zell, some rights reserved (CC BY-SA)

fertilizerSchedule: 30 kg FYM + 250g N, 125g P, 250g K per plant/year via drip fertigation.
harvestSigns: Fruits turn deep glossy red with flat sides and metallic ringing sound when tapped.
storageAdvice: Waxing and paper carton packing; stores at 5°C for up to 2 months.
description: Pomegranate (Bhagawa cultivar) is an ultra high-value export crop of arid Karnataka and Rayalaseema, yielding crimson ruby arils with global demand.
descriptionKn: ಚಿತ್ರದುರ್ಗ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಗಲಕೋಟೆಯ ಭಗವಾ ದಾಳಿಂಬೆಯು ವಿಶ್ವದ ಅತ್ಯುನ್ನತ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭರ್ಜರಿ ಬೆಲೆ ಗಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: மாதுளை வறண்ட நிலத்தில் சொட்டுநீர் பாசனத்தில் பல மடங்கு வருமானம் தரும் மதிப்புமிக்க பழப்பயிர்.
descriptionTe: దానిమ్మ అనంతపురం, బాగల్‌కోట్ ప్రాంతాలలో రైతులకు కోట్ల రూపాయల సంపదను సృష్టిస్తున్న రత్నం.
risks: Bacterial blight (Telya / Xanthomonas axonopodis) during cloudy monsoon rains
Fruit borer butterfly (Deudorix isocrates)
benefits: Highest per-kg export price in Europe and Gulf countries (₹80-₹150/kg farm gate)
Loves dry heat and low humidity during ripening

name: Potato
confidenceNote: Hassan (potato bowl of Karnataka) & Nilgiris / Kodaikanal benchmarks (Kufri Jyoti / Kufri Surya).

images.author: (c) dmitry tretjakov, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC), uploaded by dmitry tretjakov

spacing: 60 cm x 20 cm on ridges with earthing up
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 tonnes + 60:40:50 kg N:P:K per acre (earthing up at 30 days).
harvestSigns: Vines turn yellow and dry up; tuber skin sets firm and does not peel with thumb pressure.
storageAdvice: Cure in dark shade for 10 days; store in cold storage at 4-7°C with CIPC sprout inhibitor.
description: Potato is a premier short-duration cash tuber. Hassan in Karnataka and the Nilgiris produce thousands of truckloads for chips manufacturers and everyday household cooking.
descriptionKn: ಹಾಸನದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಆಲೂಗಡ್ಡೆ ಕೇವಲ 90 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ, ಭಾರಿ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯಿರುವ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: நீலகிரி உருளைக்கிழங்கு சுவைக்கு பெயர் பெற்றது. சிப்ஸ் தயாரிப்பு மற்றும் சமையலுக்கு பெரும் தேவை.
descriptionTe: బంగాళాదుంప అతి తక్కువ రోజుల్లో భారీ దిగుబడినిచ్చే అత్యంత ప్రాచుర్యం పొందిన కూరగాయ పంట.
risks: Late blight (Phytophthora infestans) during continuous misty rain
Bacterial wilt in warm wet soils
benefits: 90-day turnaround
Huge buy-back demand from wafer and chips companies

name: Proso Millet (Baragu / Panivaragu)
confidenceNote: Standard ICAR minor millet package of practices.

images.author: (c) nastusha, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC)

fertilizerSchedule: 15:8:8 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Drooping panicles turn straw yellow.
storageAdvice: Sun dry and de-husk for immediate sales or seed bank storage.
description: Proso millet (Panivaragu/Baragu) has the lowest water requirement of any cereal (only 200 mm water) and matures in 60-70 days.
descriptionKn: ಬರಗು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ನೀರು (200 ಮಿ.ಮೀ) ಬೇಡುವ ಮತ್ತು 65 ದಿನದಲ್ಲೇ ಬರುವ ಮುಂಗಾರು ಅಥವಾ ಬೇಸಿಗೆ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: பனிவரகு மிகக்குறைந்த நீரில் (200 மி.மீ) 65 நாட்களில் அறுவடை தரும் அற்புத தானியம்.
descriptionTe: వరిగలు అతి తక్కువ నీటితో కేవలం 65 రోజుల్లో దిగుబడినిచ్చే అత్యవసర పంట.
risks: Bird damage at maturity due to open panicle structure
benefits: Lowest water requirement of any cultivated grain
Super short 65-day crop cycle

name: Pumpkin (Sihi Kumbalakayi)
confidenceNote: Standard South Indian cucurbit benchmark (Arka Chandan / Co 2).

images.author: Wikimedia Commons Contributor

fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 35:25:25 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Rind turns deep orange/yellow-brown and stalk turns corky and dry.
storageAdvice: Cure in sun for 3 days; keeps in ambient storage for 4-6 months.
description: Pumpkin is a hardy, high-yielding vegetable loaded with beta-carotene (Vitamin A). Stores for months without cold storage.
descriptionKn: ಸಿಹಿಕುಂಬಳವು ವಿಟಮಿನ್ ಎ ಸಮೃದ್ಧವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ತಿಂಗಳುಗಟ್ಟಲೆ ಕೆಡದೆ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿಡಬಹುದು.
descriptionTa: மஞ்சள் பூசணி வைட்டமின் ஏ நிறைந்தது. பல மாதங்கள் கெடாமல் இருக்கும் எளிய பயிர்.
descriptionTe: గుమ్మడి విటమిన్ ఏ పుష్కలంగా ఉండే పంట. ఎక్కువ కాలం నిల్వ ఉండే సులభమైన సాగు.
risks: Fruit fly
Mosaic virus
benefits: Zero cold storage needed for 4-6 months
High tonnage with minimal labor

name: Radish (Moolangi)
confidenceNote: Shortest duration root vegetable (Pusa Chetki / Arka Nishant).

images.author: no rights reserved, uploaded by 葉子

fertilizerSchedule: FYM 6 tonnes + 25:15:20 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Roots reach 20-25 cm length and are crisp and succulent before becoming pithy.
storageAdvice: Wash roots, trim tops, and tie into bundles of 5-10; market immediately.
description: Radish is the fastest vegetable crop in farming, ready to harvest and sell in just 45 days from direct seed sowing.
descriptionKn: ಕೇವಲ 45 ದಿನದಲ್ಲೇ ಕೊಯ್ಲಿಗೆ ಬರುವ ಅತಿ ವೇಗದ ನಗದು ತರಕಾರಿ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: 45 நாட்களில் அறுவடையாகும் மிகக் குறுகிய கால வேர்க் காய்கறி.
descriptionTe: కేవలం 45 రోజుల్లోనే మార్కెట్‌కు వచ్చే అత్యంత వేగవంతమైన దుంప కూరగాయ.
risks: Flea beetles on young cotyledons
Pithiness if harvest is delayed
benefits: 45-day turnover enables 5-6 cycles per year
Excellent intercrop on sugarcane and potato ridges

name: Red Gram / Tur (Pigeonpea)
confidenceNote: Kalaburagi GI tagged Tur pulse region of Karnataka (BSMR 736 / TS 3R).

images.author: no rights reserved, uploaded by 葉子

spacing: 90 cm x 30 cm (or 150 cm x 60 cm for branching varieties)
fertilizerSchedule: 10:20:10 kg N:P:K + Rhizobium seed treatment + Gypsum 80 kg at flowering.
harvestSigns: 75-80% pods turn brown and rattle when shaken.
storageAdvice: Sun dry to 9% moisture. Mix with activated clay or neem oil (5 ml/kg) to prevent pulse beetle.
description: Red gram (Tur/Arhar) is South India's primary dal pulse, celebrated for high protein and natural nitrogen fixation.
descriptionKn: ತೊಗರಿಯು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆಯ ಬೇಳೆಕಾಳು. ಕಲಬುರಗಿ ತೊಗರಿಗೆ ಭೌಗೋಳಿಕ ಮಾನ್ಯತೆ (GI Tag) ಲಭಿಸಿದೆ.
descriptionTa: துவரம்பருப்பு அன்றாட உணவின் அச்சாணி. மண்ணில் தழைச்சத்தை நிலைநிறுத்தும் மிகச்சிறந்த பயறு.
descriptionTe: కందులు మన నిత్యావసర పప్పు ధాన్యం. వేర్లలో రైజోబియం బ్యాక్టీరియా ద్వారా భూమికి సహజ బలాన్నిస్తుంది.
risks: Helicoverpa pod borer during flowering and pod setting
Fusarium wilt in ill-drained plots
benefits: Fixes up to 40 kg atmospheric nitrogen per acre
Ideal intercrop with cotton, jowar, or groundnut

name: Red Sanders (Raktachandan)
confidenceNote: Seshachalam / Rayalaseema endemic luxury timber benchmark.

images.author: (c) V.Arun, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC), uploaded by V.Arun

rainfallMm: 500-900 mm, thrives on dry rocky hills
fertilizerSchedule: 5 kg compost per tree annually during initial 4 years.
harvestSigns: Trunk heartwood reaches deep blood-red color and high density (sinks in water).
storageAdvice: Legal forest transit permit and timber depot auction.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 500 - 800 kg heartwood per tree at 20 years
returnsEstimate: ₹2.0 Crore - ₹4.0 Crore per acre at maturity
description: Red Sanders (Rakta Chandana) is the endemic jewel of Andhra Pradesh and Eastern Ghats. Prized internationally in East Asia for traditional musical instruments and luxury carvings.
descriptionKn: ರಕ್ತಚಂದನವು ಕಲ್ಲು ಬಂಡೆಗಳ ನೆಲದಲ್ಲೂ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ದುಬಾರಿ ಮರ. ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ಬಂಗಾರದ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ.
descriptionTa: செஞ்சந்தனம் பாறை நிலங்களிலும் செழித்து வளரும் விலைமதிப்பற்ற மரப்பயிர். கோடிக்கணக்கான வருமானம் தரும்.
descriptionTe: శేషాచలం అడవుల అపురూప సంపద ఎర్రచందనం. రాతి నేలల్లో తక్కువ నీటితో పెరిగే అమూల్యమైన భవిష్యత్ నిధి.
risks: Theft and illegal poaching in mature years
Slow early vegetative growth
benefits: Grows in stony, degraded soils where agricultural crops fail completely
Astronomical timber value at maturity

name: Ridge Gourd (Heerekayi)
confidenceNote: Standard IIHR Bangalore hybrid package (Arka Prasan / Arka Sumeet).

images.author: (c) Dinesh Valke, some rights reserved (CC BY-SA)

spacing: 2 m x 1 m on pandal trellis
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 35:25:25 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Tender dark green ridges with soft skin before fiber forms.
storageAdvice: Wrap in newspaper or perforated bags; market within 48 hours.
description: Ridge gourd is a popular trailing vine vegetable cultivated on bower/pandal trellises, producing continuous tender fruits for 60 days.
descriptionKn: ಹಂದರ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಹೀರೆಕಾಯಿ ಉತ್ತಮ ಬೆಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸತತ ಆದಾಯ ತರುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: பந்தல் அமைத்து சாகுபடி செய்யப்படும் பீர்க்கங்காய் சந்தையில் அதிக கிராக்கி கொண்டது.
descriptionTe: పందిరి విధానంలో బీర సాగుతో నిరంతర నాణ్యమైన కాయలు, మంచి లాభాలు పొందవచ్చు.
risks: Downy mildew during humid rainy periods
Fruit fly causing puncture damage
benefits: High productivity on pandal trellis system
Steady consumer demand in South Indian cooking

name: Rubber (Natural Latex)
confidenceNote: Coastal Karnataka (Dakshina Kannada, Udupi) & Kerala rubber board benchmarks (RRII 105 / RRII 414).

images.author: (c) Cheongweei Gan, some rights reserved (CC BY-SA), uploaded by Cheongweei Gan

harvestMonths: Tapped every alternate day (d/2 system) from 7th year onward
rainfallMm: 2000-3500 mm in hot humid coastal/foot-hill belts
spacing: 4.9 m x 4.9 m or 6 m x 3 m
fertilizerSchedule: 10 tonnes compost + 30:30:30 kg N:P:K per acre annually.
harvestSigns: Trunk girth reaches 50 cm at 125 cm height from bud union (around year 7).
storageAdvice: Coagulate latex with formic acid in shallow trays, roll into ribbed sheets, and smoke in smokehouse for 4 days.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 700 - 1000 kg dry ribbed smoked sheets (RSS 4) per acre/year
intercroppingOptions: Pineapple, banana, ginger, turmeric during first 4 years
description: Natural rubber is the backbone of the automobile tyre and industrial rubber sector. Rubber trees in Dakshina Kannada and Kerala produce latex every alternate morning for 25 years.
descriptionKn: ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕನ್ನಡ ಮತ್ತು ಕೇರಳದ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆಯ ತೋಟಗಾರಿಕಾ ಬೆಳೆ. ನಿತ್ಯ ಮುಂಜಾನೆ ಟ್ಯಾಪಿಂಗ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಹಾಲು (ಲ್ಯಾಟೆಕ್ಸ್) ತೆಗೆದು ಧೀರ್ಘಾವಧಿ ಲಾಭ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: கன்னியாகுமரி மற்றும் கேரளாவில் பெருமளவில் பயிரிடப்படும் ரப்பர் மரங்கள் ஆட்டோமொபைல் டயர் ஆலைகளுக்கு அத்தியாவசியம்.
descriptionTe: సహజ రబ్బరు టైర్ల పరిశ్రమకు అత్యంత కీలకమైన పారిశ్రామిక తోట పంట. దశాబ్దాల పాటు ఆదాయాన్నిస్తుంది.
risks: Abnormal leaf fall (Phytophthora botryosa) during continuous heavy monsoon
Pink disease on branches
benefits: Steady alternate-day cash income from RSS sheets
Rubber Wood at end of 30 years fetches ₹1-2 Lakhs per acre for furniture boards

name: Safflower (Kusube / Kardi)
confidenceNote: North Karnataka and Marathwada deep black vertisol winter oilseed (A-1 / Annigeri 1 / PBNS 12).

images.author: no rights reserved, uploaded by 葉子

rainfallMm: Residual soil moisture in deep black soils
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 3 tonnes + 20:15:0 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Plants turn completely golden brown and spiny heads shatter easily.
storageAdvice: Sun dry seeds to below 8% moisture.
description: Safflower (Kusube) is a deep-rooted, spiny winter oilseed that draws moisture from 2 meters deep in black cotton soils. Known for cold-pressed heart-healthy Kardi oil.
descriptionKn: ಉತ್ತರ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಆನ್ನಿಗೇರಿ ಭಾಗದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕುಸುಬೆ. ಹೃದಯಕ್ಕೆ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಹಿತಕರವಾದ ತೈಲವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: கரிசல் மண்ணின் அடியில் உள்ள ஈரப்பதத்தை உறிஞ்சி வளரும் முட்கள் நிறைந்த சமையல் எண்ணெய் பயிர்.
descriptionTe: కుసుమ నల్లరేగడి నేలల్లో అడుగున ఉన్న తేమతోనే పెరిగే అద్భుతమైన నూనెగింజ పంట.
risks: Aphids (Uroleucon carthami) in early flowering
Alternaria leaf blight in cloudy weather
benefits: Zero irrigation needed in deep black soils
Acts as a natural spiny animal barrier when planted around field borders

name: Sandalwood (Sri Gandha)
confidenceNote: Institute of Wood Science and Technology (IWST Bangalore) agroforestry package.

images.author: no rights reserved, uploaded by 葉子

waterMm: 500-750 mm (needs host plant roots for hemiparasitic nourishment)
seedRate: 300-350 saplings/acre (paired with primary host Casuarina / Sesbania)
spacing: 3.5 m x 3.5 m (with primary and secondary host plants)
fertilizerSchedule: 10 kg compost per tree annually; ensure healthy growth of host plants (Tur / Desmanthus / Casuarina).
harvestSigns: Tree reaches 15-20 years age with 30-40 cm heartwood girth.
storageAdvice: Certified state forest department / KSDL extraction with legal transit permit.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 15 - 25 kg heartwood per tree at 15 years (approx. 4,500 - 6,000 kg heartwood/acre)
returnsEstimate: ₹2.5 Crore - ₹4.5 Crore per acre at 15-18 years (at ₹5,000 - ₹8,000/kg heartwood)
description: Sandalwood (Sri Gandha) is the legendary fragrant tree of Karnataka. Legalized for private cultivation, 300 trees per acre mature into a multi-crore retirement asset in 15 years.
descriptionKn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆಯ ಶ್ರೀಗಂಧ. ಕಾನೂನಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿ ರೈತರ ಜಮೀನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಲು ಮುಕ್ತವಾಗಿದ್ದು, 15 ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋಟ್ಯಂತರ ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಸಂಪತ್ತು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: சந்தன மரம் தலைமுறைக்கான தங்கச் சுரங்கம். 15-18 ஆண்டுகளில் பல கோடி ரூபாய் வருவாய் தரும் மதிப்புமிக்க வனப் பயிர்.
descriptionTe: శ్రీగంధం 15-18 ఏళ్లలో కోట్లాది రూపాయల సంపదను సృష్టించే అత్యంత ఖరీదైన చందన వృక్షం.
risks: Spike disease transmitted by leafhoppers
Security and theft risk in mature years (requires solar fencing / CCTV)
benefits: Highest legal timber value in Asia (₹6,000-₹10,000/kg)
Creates intergenerational family wealth

name: Sapota / Chiku (Cricket Ball / PKM 1)
confidenceNote: Dindigul (PKM-1) and coastal/plains sapota benchmarks.

images.author: (c) Ong Jyh Seng, some rights reserved (CC BY-SA), uploaded by Ong Jyh Seng

spacing: 8 m x 8 m or 9 m x 9 m
fertilizerSchedule: 40 kg FYM + 500g N, 250g P, 500g K per mature tree annually.
harvestSigns: Brown scurf falls off easily when rubbed with finger; scratch reveals yellowish green flesh beneath.
storageAdvice: Wash off latex in clean water, air dry, and ripen in straw for 4-5 days.
intercroppingOptions: Vegetables and pulses during first 4 years
description: Sapota (Chiku) is an exceptionally hardy, trouble-free fruit tree with virtually zero pest problems, yielding sweet fruits year after year.
descriptionKn: ಸಪೋಟಾ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಸರಳ ಹಣ್ಣಿನ ಬೆಳೆ. ಕೀಟ ರೋಗಗಳ ಕಾಟವಿಲ್ಲದೆ 30 ವರ್ಷ ಸತತ ಇಳುವರಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: சப்போட்டா பூச்சி நோய் தாக்குதல் இல்லாத மிக எளிய பழப்பயிர். ஆண்டு முழுவதும் அறுவடை தரும்.
descriptionTe: సపోటా ఎలాంటి తెగుళ్లు లేని సులువైన తోట పంట. దశాబ్దాల పాటు నిరంతర లాభాలు ఇస్తుంది.
risks: Bud borer in damp weather
benefits: Virtually zero pest/disease issues
Thrives in coastal breeze and sandy soils

name: Sesame (Til / Gingelly / Ellu)
confidenceNote: Indigenous edible and pooja oilseed of Madurai, Villupuram and Tumakuru (TMV 7 / VRI 3 / DS 5).

images.author: no rights reserved, uploaded by 葉子

spacing: 30 cm x 10 cm or broadcast with sand
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 3 tonnes + 15:10:10 kg N:P:K + Sulphur 10 kg/acre.
harvestSigns: Leaves and stems turn yellow; lower capsules start opening at the tip.
storageAdvice: Sun dry bundles upside down on tarpaulins; shake out clean seeds; dry to 6% moisture.
intercroppingOptions: Intercrop with pearl millet or castor
description: Sesame (Til/Ellu) has the highest oil content of any seed (50%) and commands extraordinary prices (₹12,000-₹16,000/quintal) for traditional cold-pressed gingelly oil.
descriptionKn: ಎಳ್ಳು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ವೆಚ್ಚದಲ್ಲಿ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಬೆಲೆ (ಕ್ವಿಂಟಾಲಿಗೆ ₹12,000-₹16,000) ತಂದುಕೊಡುವ ಸುವರ್ಣ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: நல்லெண்ணெய் தயாரிப்பிற்கு பயன்படும் எள் குறைந்த நீரில் அதிக லாபம் ஈட்டித் தரும் அற்புத பயிர்.
descriptionTe: నువ్వులు అత్యధిక మార్కెట్ ధర కలిగిన నూనెగింజ పంట. అతి తక్కువ పెట్టుబడితో అధిక లాభాలు.
risks: Phyllody disease (floral parts transform into green leafy structures) transmitted by leafhoppers
benefits: One of the highest profit-to-cost ratios in Indian agriculture (up to 700% ROI)
Matures in 80 days with only 1-2 light irrigations

name: Shatavari (Queen of Herbs)
confidenceNote: Premier women's health and rasayana Ayurvedic root benchmark.

images.author: Wikimedia Commons Contributor

fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 tonnes + 30:25:35 kg N:P:K per acre annually.
harvestSigns: Fleshy tuberous root clusters reach 30-40 cm length and 2 cm thickness.
storageAdvice: Boil tubers in hot water for 5 minutes, peel outer skin, and sun dry until ivory white.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 1.5 - 2.5 Tonnes peeled dried roots/acre at 20 months
intercroppingOptions: Short pulses and vegetables in 1st year
description: Shatavari ("Who possesses a hundred husbands") is Ayurveda's supreme rejuvenating tonic for women's reproductive vitality. High saponin roots fetch premium prices from pharmaceutical extractors.
descriptionKn: ಶತಾವರಿಯು ಆಯುರ್ವೇದದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾದ ಬೇರು ಬೆಳೆ. ಕೆಜಿಗೆ ₹200 ಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬೆಲೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: தண்ணீர்விட்டான் கிழங்கு பெண்களின் ஆரோக்கியத்திற்கு அருமருந்தான உயர் மதிப்பு மூலிகை.
descriptionTe: శతావరి ఆయుర్వేదంలో అగ్రగణ్యమైన ఔషధ దుంప. మార్కెట్లో నిరంతరం భారీ డిమాండ్.
risks: Crown rot in ill-drained waterlogged plots
benefits: High value peeled dried root market
Prickly climbing nature prevents grazing by cattle

name: Snake Gourd (Padavalakayi)
confidenceNote: Standard pandal cucurbit of South India (Co 1 / PKM 1 / Kaumudi).

images.author: (c) 106611639464075912591, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC-SA), uploaded by 106611639464075912591

fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 35:25:25 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Tender cylindrical green striped fruits before seeds harden.
storageAdvice: Tie small stone pebbles to fruit tips to keep them straight; market within 48 hours.
description: Snake gourd is a high-yielding pandal vegetable prized for its easy digestibility and light cooling culinary properties.
descriptionKn: ಹಂದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಪಡವಲಕಾಯಿ ಶರೀರಕ್ಕೆ ತಂಪು ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ತಮ ಆದಾಯ ನೀಡುವ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: பந்தலில் கொடி கட்டி வளர்க்கப்படும் புடலங்காய் தொடர் விளைச்சல் தரும்.
descriptionTe: పందిరిపై సాగయ్యే పొట్లకాయ సులభంగా జీర్ణమయ్యే రుచికరమైన కూరగాయ.
risks: Fruit fly
Downy mildew
benefits: Heavy tonnage per acre on pandals
Quick commercial maturity

name: Sorghum (Jowar)
confidenceNote: Standard UAS Dharwad & PJTSAU Hyderabad recommendations for Deccan vertisols.

images.author: (c) J. Richard Abbott, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC), uploaded by J. Richard Abbott

fertilizerSchedule: 30:15:15 kg N:P:K per acre (half N at sowing, half at 35 days).
harvestSigns: Black layer develops on the hilum (base) of grains and grains become chalky white/hard.
storageAdvice: Sun-dry to below 10% moisture before storing in sealed drums.
description: Sorghum is the backbone of dryland farming in North Karnataka and Telangana, providing staple grain and sweet stover fodder.
descriptionKn: ಉತ್ತರ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಜೀವನಾಡಿ ಬೆಳೆ. ರೊಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಜಾನುವಾರುಗಳಿಗೆ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಮೇವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: வறண்ட நிலப்பகுதிகளுக்கு ஏற்ற முக்கிய தானியம். தானியமும் வைக்கோலும் அதிக மதிப்புடையவை.
descriptionTe: తెలంగాణ మరియు ఉత్తర కర్ణాటకలో అత్యంత ఆదరణ పొందిన మెట్ట పంట. పోషకాలు మెండు.
risks: Shoot fly in late-sown crops
Grain mold if unseasonal rain occurs at harvest
benefits: Deep taproot system recovers moisture from deep black soil
Valuable sweet stover for dairy cows

name: Soybean
confidenceNote: Major Kharif pulse-oilseed of Belagavi, Bidar and Nizamabad districts (DSb 21 / JS 335).

images.author: no rights reserved, uploaded by 葉子

fertilizerSchedule: 12:30:15 kg N:P:K + Bradyrhizobium japonicum seed inoculation.
harvestSigns: Leaves drop, pods turn yellow-brown, and seeds rattle.
storageAdvice: Dry gently to 10% moisture (avoid high heat which cracks seed coats).
description: Soybean is the world's richest plant protein and oil crop, widely cultivated in Northern Karnataka and Telangana for oil mills and export cake.
descriptionKn: ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರೋಟೀನ್ (40%) ಮತ್ತು ಎಣ್ಣೆ (20%) ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯ ಬೇಳೆಕಾಳು ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: அதிக புரதச்சத்தும் எண்ணெய் சத்தும் கொண்ட மிக முக்கியமான வணிக பயறு பயிர்.
descriptionTe: అత్యధిక ప్రొటీన్లు మరియు నూనె కలిగిన లాభదాయకమైన పప్పు-నూనెగింజ పంట.
risks: Stem fly at seedling stage
Rust disease under wet monsoon spells
benefits: Guaranteed MSP purchase and oil mill demand
Leaves fall on ground before harvest, adding 1.5 tonnes organic mulch per acre

name: Subabul (Miracle Forage & Pulp Tree)
confidenceNote: High protein fodder and paper mill contract tree of Andhra & Telangana (K-8 / Cunningham).

images.author: no rights reserved, uploaded by 葉子

durationDays: Perennial fodder bush (10+ years with 6 cuts/year) or 3-year pulpwood
harvestMonths: First cut at 90 days, then every 45-50 days for forage
spacing: 1 m x 0.5 m (forage hedgerow) or 2m x 2m (paper pulp)
fertilizerSchedule: 10:20:0 kg N:P:K basal; fixes all own nitrogen after nodulation.
harvestSigns: Cut leafy branches at 75-100 cm height before woody stems develop.
storageAdvice: Sun dry leaflets to produce green protein leaf meal (24% crude protein).
intercroppingOptions: Contour alley cropping with dryland cereals
description: Subabul is known as the "Alfalfa of the Tropics". Producing up to 45 tonnes of 24% crude protein fodder per year, it fixes massive soil nitrogen and doubles cattle weight gain.
descriptionKn: ಶೇ 24% ಪ್ರೋಟೀನ್ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಸುಬಾಬುಲ್ ಬರಪೀಡಿತ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ದ್ವಿದಳ ಮೇವು.
descriptionTa: சவுண்டல் வறட்சியிலும் செழித்து வளரும் அதிக புரதம் கொண்ட கால்நடை தீவன மரம்.
descriptionTe: సుబాబుల్ పేపర్ మిల్లులకు మరియు పశువుల మేతకు ఎంతో అనువైన తక్కువ ఖర్చుతో పెరిగే లాభదాయక చెట్టు.
risks: Heteropsylla cubana (psyllid insect) in cold damp weather
benefits: Fixes over 100 kg atmospheric nitrogen per acre per year
24% high crude protein replaces expensive cattle feed concentrates

name: Sugarcane
confidenceNote: Mandya (Sugar city) & Belagavi Cauvery/Krishna basin factory benchmarks (Co 86032 / Co 0238).

images.author: (c) beingplace, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC), uploaded by beingplace

harvestMonths: December to April (12 months after planting)
seedRate: 35,000-40,000 two-budded setts/acre (or 4,000 single bud seedlings via SSI method)
fertilizerSchedule: 10 tonnes FYM + 100:40:50 kg N:P:K per acre (apply N in 4 splits up to 90 days; earthing up at 90 days).
harvestSigns: Leaves turn yellow; brix reading exceeds 18-20% with hand refractometer.
storageAdvice: Crush in sugar mill within 24-48 hours of cutting to prevent inversion of sucrose to glucose.
description: Sugarcane is South India's major agro-industrial cash crop. Backed by sugar factory statutory FRP pricing and thriving local organic jaggery (Bella) cottage units.
descriptionKn: ಮಂಡ್ಯದ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ನಾಡಿನ ಜೀವನಾಡಿ ಬೆಳೆ. ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾವಯವ ಆಲೆಮನೆ ಬೆಲ್ಲ ತಯಾರಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಭಾರಿ ಆದಾಯ.
descriptionTa: கரும்பு சர்க்கரை ஆலைகளுக்கு பெருமளவில் சாகுபடி செய்யப்படும் முக்கிய பணப்பயிர். பொங்கல் விழாவின் நாயகன்.
descriptionTe: చెరకు తీపి పంట. సహకార చక్కెర మిల్లులు మరియు బెల్లం తయారీ ద్వారా రైతులకు స్థిరమైన వార్షికాదాయం.
risks: Early shoot borer and internode borer
Red rot (Colletotrichum falcatum) fungal infection
benefits: Guaranteed factory purchase with statutory Fair and Remunerative Price (FRP)
Trash mulching saves 30% water and enriches organic carbon

name: Sunflower
confidenceNote: Major edible oilseed of Bellary, Koppal, Bagalkot and Kurnool (KBSH 44 / DRSH 1).

images.author: (c) Emily Scherer, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC), uploaded by Emily Scherer

fertilizerSchedule: FYM 4 tonnes + 25:35:15 kg N:P:K + Boron 2 kg/acre (essential to prevent hollow seeds).
harvestSigns: Back of the flower head turns lemon yellow to brown; bracts turn dry.
storageAdvice: Sun dry seeds to 8% moisture before storing in clean dry gunny bags.
description: Sunflower is a drought-tolerant commercial oilseed with premium heart-healthy polyunsaturated oil (PUFA), growing across all three seasons in Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh.
descriptionKn: ಸೂರ್ಯಕಾಂತಿಯು ಕೇವಲ 90 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ, ಬರವನ್ನು ತಡೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಹೃದಯಸ್ನೇಹಿ ಎಣ್ಣೆಕಾಳು ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: சூரியகாந்தி குறுகிய காலத்தில் விளையும் ஆரோக்கியமான சமையல் எண்ணெய் தரும் முக்கிய பயிர்.
descriptionTe: పొద్దుతిరుగుడు నల్లరేగడి నేలల్లో అతి తక్కువ కాలంలో అధిక లాభాలు అందించే నూనెగింజ పంట.
risks: Sunflower Necrosis Disease transmitted by thrips
Poor seed filling if Boron is deficient (apply 2g Borax/Litre at flowering)
benefits: Fits into any season (Kharif, Rabi, Summer)
Ready cash purchase by local edible oil mills

name: Super Napier Grass (Hybrid CO-5)
confidenceNote: TNAU Coimbatore & KMF Karnataka dairy cooperative benchmark for green forage production.

images.author: no rights reserved, uploaded by 葉子

waterMm: 800-1200 mm (recycled dairy wash water / drip / furrow)
durationDays: Perennial fodder (harvest every 45-50 days for 4-5 years)
harvestMonths: First cut at 75-80 days, then every 45-50 days year-round
spacing: 60 cm x 50 cm or 90 cm x 60 cm
fertilizerSchedule: 15 tonnes FYM/compost + 60:30:25 kg N:P:K basal; apply 25 kg Urea + slurry after every cut.
harvestSigns: Cut at 1.5 to 2.0 meters height when crude protein is at peak (10-12%) and stems are juicy and succulent.
storageAdvice: Chop in chaff cutter (2-3 cm pieces); feed fresh or ensile in plastic silo drums for summer.
returnsEstimate: Saves ₹2,50,000 - ₹3,50,000 in commercial cattle feed and boosts cow milk yield by 1.5-2 Litres/day
intercroppingOptions: Intercrop with Hedge Lucerne (Desmanthus) 3:1 ratio to provide complete balanced protein-energy diet
description: Super Napier CO-5 is the miracle green fodder of Indian dairy farming. Yielding an astounding 150-200 tonnes per acre per year across 7-8 cuts, 0.5 acre sustains 6-8 high-yielding dairy cows.
descriptionKn: ಹೈನುಗಾರರ ಪಾಲಿನ ಕಾಮಧೇನು. ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ 150-200 ಟನ್ ಹಸಿರು ಮೇವು ನೀಡಿ, ಪ್ರತಿ ಹಸುವಿನ ಹಾಲು 1.5-2 ಲೀಟರ್ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: பால் பண்ணை விவசாயிகளுக்கு வரம். ஏக்கருக்கு 180 டன் பசுந்தீவனம் தந்து தீவன செலவை பாதியாக குறைக்கும்.
descriptionTe: పాడి రైతులకు వరప్రసాదం. ఎకరానికి ఏటా 150-200 టన్నుల పచ్చిగడ్డిని అందిస్తూ పాల దిగుబడిని గణనీయంగా పెంచుతుంది.
risks: Stem borer occasionally during hot summer
benefits: Astonishing biomass yield (up to 200 tonnes green fodder/acre/year)
Cuts feed expenses by 50% and dramatically improves milk fat and SNF

name: Sweet Lime / Orange (Mosambi)
confidenceNote: Nalgonda, Anantapur and Bagalkot citrus fruit belt (Sathgudi / Mosambi).

images.author: Wikimedia Commons Contributor

harvestMonths: October to December and March to May
fertilizerSchedule: 40 kg FYM + 500g N, 250g P, 500g K per mature tree annually.
harvestSigns: Rind color breaks from dark green to light yellowish green; juice brix reaches 10-12%.
storageAdvice: Pack in CFB boxes; stores 15-20 days at ambient temperature.
description: Sweet Orange (Mosambi/Sathgudi) is South India's favorite recovery and hydration fruit, dominating fruit markets and roadside juice stalls year-round.
descriptionKn: ಮೂಸಂಬಿಯು ರೋಗಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಶಿಫಾರಸು ಮಾಡಲ್ಪಡುವ ಪೌಷ್ಟಿಕ ಜ್ಯೂಸ್ ಹಣ್ಣು.
descriptionTa: சாத்துக்குடி உடலுக்கு உடனடி புத்துணர்ச்சி தரும் மருத்துவ குணம் மிக்க பழப்பயிர்.
descriptionTe: బత్తాయి నల్గొండ, అనంతపురం జిల్లాలలో అత్యధికంగా సాగయ్యే ప్రధాన వాణిజ్య పండ్ల తోట.
risks: Citrus gummosis / phytophthora foot rot in wet soils
Fruit sucking moth at ripening stage
benefits: Steady institutional purchase by fruit juice vendors and supermarkets
Rangpur lime rootstock provides high drought tolerance

name: Sweet Potato
confidenceNote: Standard ICAR-CTCRI Trivandrum package (Sree Bhadra / Sree Arun).

images.author: no rights reserved, uploaded by 葉子

fertilizerSchedule: FYM 5 tonnes + 25:20:35 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Leaves turn yellow and dry; cutting a tuber reveals latex that dries cleanly white without turning black.
storageAdvice: Cure tubers in shade for 4 days before packing.
description: Sweet potato is a climate-smart, nutritious tuber with high Vitamin A and C, maturing in just 105 days with minimal water.
descriptionKn: ಸಿಹಿ ಗೆಣಸು ಕೇವಲ 100 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ, ನಾರಿನಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಟಮಿನ್‌ಗಳಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದ ಸುಲಭ ಗೆಡ್ಡೆ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: சர்க்கரைவள்ளிக்கிழங்கு குறுகிய காலத்தில் விளையும் ஆரோக்கியமான சத்துமிகுந்த கிழங்கு பயிர்.
descriptionTe: చిలగడదుంప అతి తక్కువ సమయంలో అధిక దిగుబడినిచ్చే ఆరోగ్యకరమైన దుంప పంట.
risks: Sweet potato weevil (Cylas formicarius) boring into tubers
benefits: Low input and fast maturity (105 days)
Vines provide lush green cattle fodder

name: Sweet Sorghum
confidenceNote: Biofuel and jaggery syrup multi-purpose crop for dryland tracts.

images.author: (c) Tara Severns, some rights reserved (CC BY), uploaded by Tara Severns

fertilizerSchedule: 35:20:15 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Stems contain 15-18% brix sugar when grain reaches milk-dough stage.
storageAdvice: Crush stalks in cane crusher within 48 hours for ethanol or syrup.
description: Sweet sorghum provides grain for food, juicy sweet stalks for ethanol and jaggery syrup, and bagasse for animal feed.
descriptionKn: ಧಾನ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಿಹಿ ಕಾಂಡ ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ನೀಡುವ ಬಹುಪಯೋಗಿ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: தானியத்துடன் இனிப்பு சாறும் தரும் எத்தனால் தயாரிப்பு பயிர்.
descriptionTe: ధాన్యంతో పాటు తీపి రసాన్ని ఇచ్చే బహుళ ప్రయోజన పంట.
risks: Stem borer
benefits: Dual purpose for food and bio-energy

name: Tapioca / Cassava
confidenceNote: Major industrial sago and edible tuber crop of Salem, Dharmapuri and Kerala (MVD 1 / Sree Vijaya).

images.author: no rights reserved, uploaded by 葉子

fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 tonnes + 40:25:60 kg N:P:K per acre (potash is critical for starch).
harvestSigns: Lower leaves shed, upper leaves turn yellow, and soil cracks around stem base.
storageAdvice: Process into chips or sell directly to sago factories within 48 hours of harvest.
description: Tapioca (Maravalli Kizhangu) is the starch king of Tamil Nadu and Kerala, feeding hundreds of sago/wafer factories and edible markets.
descriptionKn: ಮರಗೆಣಸು ಸಬ್ಬಕ್ಕಿ ಮತ್ತು ಗಂಜಿ ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಭಾರಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಬರಾಜಾಗುವ ಲಾಭದಾಯಕ ಗೆಡ್ಡೆ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: சேலம், நாமக்கல் பகுதியின் பிரதான பணப்பயிர். ஜவ்வரிசி ஆலைகளுக்கு பெருமளவில் விற்கப்படுகிறது.
descriptionTe: కర్రపెండలం సాబుదానా తయారీ పరిశ్రమలకు ముడిసరుకుగా అత్యధిక లాభాలు తెచ్చే పంట.
risks: Cassava Mosaic Disease transmitted by whitefly
Red spider mites in dry hot summer
benefits: Extremely drought-resilient and pest-free
Guaranteed sale to industrial sago and starch mills

name: Tea (Nilgiris Fragrant Tea)
confidenceNote: Nilgiris (Ooty / Coonoor) & Munnar GI fragrant tea garden benchmarks.

images.author: (c) Stuart Cable, some rights reserved (CC BY), uploaded by Stuart Cable

waterMm: 1500-2500 mm with high humidity and mist
seasons: Year-round plucking (peak quality during winter frost in Dec-Jan)
rainfallMm: 1500-3000 mm on high-altitude mist-covered slopes (1000m - 2200m MSL)
spacing: 1.2 m x 0.75 m on contour terraces
fertilizerSchedule: compost + 120:40:80 kg N:P:K per acre/year in 4 splits.
harvestSigns: Two tender leaves and a terminal bud ("two leaves and a bud") plucked carefully by hand or shears.
storageAdvice: Transport fresh green leaves immediately to tea factory for withering and oxidation.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 8,000 - 12,000 kg green leaf/acre/year (approx. 2000-2500 kg made orthodox/CTC tea)
description: Nilgiris tea is world-famous for its bright golden liquor, delicate floral fragrance, and high briskness. Harvested weekly on misty mountain slopes.
descriptionKn: ನೀಲಗಿರಿಯ ಚಹಾವು ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಿ ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದು, ಪ್ರತಿ ವಾರ ಎರಡು ಎಲೆ ಒಂದು ಮೊಗ್ಗು ಕೊಯ್ಲು ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: நீலகிரி தேயிலை உலகப்புகழ் பெற்ற நறுமணம் கொண்டது. வாரம் ஒருமுறை கொழுந்து இலைகள் பறித்து தொடர் வருவாய் தரும்.
descriptionTe: నీలగిరి కొండల్లో పండే తేయాకు అద్భుతమైన సువాసనతో అంతర్జాతీయ మార్కెట్లో మంచి గిరాకీని కలిగి ఉంది.
risks: Blister blight (Exobasidium vexans) in cold misty monsoons
Red spider mite
benefits: Weekly harvest creates continuous year-round worker employment and cash flow
Protected GI origin status in global tea auctions

name: Tomato
confidenceNote: Kolar, Chikkaballapur, Madanapalle and Dindigul major tomato producing belts (Arka Rakshak / Saaho).

images.author: (c) alexkehl, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC)

spacing: 90 cm x 45 cm (or 120 cm x 60 cm with trellis)
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 tonnes + 75:50:50 kg N:P:K via drip fertigation + Calcium Nitrate & Boron foliar sprays.
harvestSigns: Fruits turn pink/breaker stage for distant transport or ripe red for local market.
storageAdvice: Pack in plastic crates. Store at 12-15°C; do not store below 10°C to avoid chilling injury.
description: Tomato is the premier commercial cash vegetable of South India, yielding high returns with trellis cultivation and drip irrigation.
descriptionKn: ಕೋಲಾರ, ಚಿಕ್ಕಬಳ್ಳಾಪುರದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯ ತರಕಾರಿ. ಹನಿ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಮತ್ತು ತಂತಿ ಹಂದರ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯಿಂದ ಭರ್ಜರಿ ಆದಾಯ.
descriptionTa: திண்டுக்கல், சேலம் பகுதியின் முதன்மை காய்கறி பயிர். சொட்டுநீர் பாசனத்தில் அபார லாபம் தரும்.
descriptionTe: మదనపల్లి మరియు అనంతపురం ప్రాంతాల ప్రధాన వాణిజ్య కూరగాయ. డ్రిప్ విధానంతో అధిక లాభాలు.
risks: Early and Late blight during cloudy wet weather
Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV) transmitted by whiteflies
benefits: Harvest starts 65 days after transplanting and continues for 2 months
Exceptional income with triple disease resistant hybrids like Arka Rakshak

name: Tuberose (Sugandharaja / Nilasampangi)
confidenceNote: IIHR Bangalore commercial floriculture package (Prajwal / Vaibhav).

images.author: (c) SONU KUMAR, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC), uploaded by SONU KUMAR

durationDays: Perennial bulb crop (2-3 years per planting)
harvestMonths: Starts 90 days after bulb planting and produces continuously for 2.5 years
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 tonnes + 80:60:80 kg N:P:K per acre/year in 4 splits.
harvestSigns: Individual florets picked for loose flower market or whole spikes cut when 1-2 lower florets open.
storageAdvice: Cut stems placed in clean water buckets with 2% sucrose.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 4 - 6 Tonnes loose florets or 1,20,000 cut spikes/acre/year
description: Tuberose (Sugandharaja / Prajwal) is South India's most aromatic cut and loose flower, yielding continuous daily harvests for nearly 3 years from a single planting.
descriptionKn: ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಗಡ್ಡೆ ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ 3 ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಸತತವಾಗಿ ದಿನನಿತ್ಯ ಹೂವು ಮತ್ತು ಆದಾಯ ನೀಡುವ ಸುಗಂಧರಾಜ.
descriptionTa: நிலச்சம்பங்கி நறுமணம் மிக்க மலர். ஒரு முறை நடவு செய்தால் 3 ஆண்டுகள் வரை தொடர் அறுவடை.
descriptionTe: సుగంధరాజ ఒకసారి నాటితే మూడేళ్ల పాటు నిరంతరం పూత పూస్తూ రైతులకు ఆదాయం ఇచ్చే తోట.
risks: Root-knot nematode (Meloidogyne incognita)
Sclerotium stem rot
benefits: One-time planting yields harvest for 3 years
High value for both domestic garlands and perfumery extract

name: Tulsi (Holy Basil / Krishna Tulsi)
confidenceNote: Ayurvedic sacred herb with high eugenol essential oil (CIM-Ayu / Krishna Tulsi).

images.author: (c) 小铖/Smalltown, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC), uploaded by 小铖/Smalltown

harvestMonths: First cut at 75 days, then every 45-50 days (3-4 cuts/year)
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 6 tonnes + 25:15:15 kg N:P:K per acre annually.
harvestSigns: Cut top 15-20 cm foliage at full flowering stage when eugenol content peaks.
storageAdvice: Shade dry leaves on clean sheets to preserve fragrant green color and essential oil.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 2 - 3 Tonnes dry herb/acre/year (or 25-30 kg essential oil)
description: Tulsi is India's most revered sacred medicinal plant. Huge international demand from herbal tea brands (Organic India) and cough syrup manufacturers for clean shade-dried leaves.
descriptionKn: ಪವಿತ್ರ ತುಳಸಿಯು ಆಯುರ್ವೇದ ಚಹಾ ಮತ್ತು ಔಷಧ ಕಂಪನಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಭಾರಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಬರಾಜಾಗುವ ಸುಲಭ ಲಾಭದಾಯಕ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: துளசி மூலிகை தேநீர் மற்றும் மருந்து தயாரிப்பில் பெருமளவில் பயன்படும் புனித மூலிகை.
descriptionTe: తులసి ఆయుర్వేదంలో అత్యంత ప్రముఖమైనది. హెర్బల్ టీ కంపెనీలకు నిరంతరం అమ్ముడవుతుంది.
risks: Leaf webber in monsoon
benefits: Shade-dried organic leaves fetch ₹60-₹100/kg from herbal brands
Natural insect repellent aroma protects neighboring crops

name: Turmeric (Haldi / Arisina)
confidenceNote: Erode (Yellow city GI), Nizamabad and Chamarajanagar turmeric benchmarks (IISR Pragati / Salem / BSR 2).

images.author: SKsiddhartthan

spacing: 45 cm x 20 cm on broad ridges/raised beds with organic mulch
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 12 tonnes + 60:30:60 kg N:P:K + Trichoderma viride + Micronutrient foliar spray.
harvestSigns: Leaves turn dry, yellow, and collapse completely.
storageAdvice: Boil rhizomes in copper/GI pans until soft; sun dry for 10-15 days on cement floors; polish with mechanical polisher.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 20 - 26 Quintals cured polished dry turmeric/acre (approx. 10-12 tonnes fresh)
description: Turmeric ("Golden Spice") is celebrated globally for its anti-inflammatory curcumin content. Erode and Nizamabad mandis trade thousands of crores of turmeric annually.
descriptionKn: ಅರಿಶಿನವು ಚಿನ್ನದ ಬೆಳೆ. ಚಾಮರಾಜನಗರ ಮತ್ತು ಈರೋಡ್‌ನ ಹೈ-ಕರ್ಕ್ಯುಮಿನ್ ಅರಿಶಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಜಾಗತಿಕ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರಿ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯಿದೆ.
descriptionTa: ஈரோடு "மஞ்சள் நகரம்" என போற்றப்படுகிறது. உலகளவில் மருத்துவ குணம் கொண்ட மஞ்சளுக்கு எப்போதும் உச்ச விலை உண்டு.
descriptionTe: నిజామాబాద్ పసుపు దేశంలోనే ప్రసిద్ధి. కర్క్యుమిన్ ఎక్కువగా ఉండే పసుపు సాగుతో రైతులు కోట్లలో వ్యాపారం చేస్తున్నారు.
risks: Rhizome rot (Pythium aphanidermatum) in waterlogged clay soils
Shoot borer (Conogethes punctiferalis)
benefits: Dried polished turmeric can be stored for 2-3 years, waiting for peak commodity price peaks
Booming export as herbal nutraceutical and organic extract

name: Vanilla
confidenceNote: High-value orchid intercrop in areca and coffee estates (needs hand pollination).

images.author: (c) Ariel Salinas Seq., some rights reserved (CC BY-NC), uploaded by Ariel Salinas Seq.

harvestMonths: August to November (9 months after hand pollination)
rainfallMm: 1500-2500 mm in 50% shade with thick leaf mulch
seedRate: 800-1000 vine cuttings/acre (trailed on live arecanut / gliricidia supports)
fertilizerSchedule: Well-rotted FYM and vermicompost (shallow feeder; avoids harsh chemical fertilizers).
harvestSigns: Beans lose dark green sheen and blossom end turns pale yellow.
storageAdvice: Sweat, ferment, and slow dry beans over 2-3 months until dark brown, supple, and vanillin crystals appear.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 200 - 350 kg cured cured black vanilla beans/acre
description: Vanilla is the world's second most expensive spice after saffron. Grown as a climbing orchid on arecanut palms in coastal Karnataka and Kerala, cured beans fetch ₹2,000-₹4,000 per kg.
descriptionKn: ಅಡಿಕೆ ಮರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹಬ್ಬಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ವೆನಿಲ್ಲಾ ವಿಶ್ವದ ಎರಡನೇ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ದುಬಾರಿ ಸಾಂಬಾರ ಬೆಳೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಕೆಜಿಗೆ ₹2,000-₹4,000 ಬೆಲೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: வெணிலா உலகிலேயே குங்குமப்பூவிற்கு அடுத்தபடியாக மிக அதிக விலை கொண்ட நறுமண பயிர்.
descriptionTe: వెనిల్లా అంతర్జాతీయంగా అత్యధిక విలువ కలిగిన సుగంధ ద్రవ్యం. తోటల్లో అంతరపంటగా అద్భుత ఆదాయం.
risks: Root rot (Fusarium oxysporum) in ill-drained soil
Requires daily hand pollination of flowers in morning hours
benefits: Astonishing price per kilogram (up to ₹3,500/kg)
Utilizes shade in existing arecanut orchards

name: Vetiver (Lavancha / Khus)
confidenceNote: Indigenous aromatic cooling root of South India (Dharini / Gulabi).

images.author: (c) feno, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC), uploaded by feno

harvestMonths: January to March (12 months after planting)
spacing: 60 cm x 30 cm on loose sandy loams
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 6 tonnes + 25:15:15 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Dig out roots at 12 months when spongy, fragrant, and deep brown.
storageAdvice: Wash roots thoroughly with water jet to remove soil; sun dry for 3 days; pack in clean bags for distillation or handicraft weaving.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 1.2 - 1.8 Tonnes dried fragrant roots/acre (or 10-15 kg super-premium Khus oil)
intercroppingOptions: Soil conservation hedge on contour bunds
description: Vetiver (Lavancha/Vettiveru) is the miracle root of South India. Used for cooling drinking water, Ayurvedic bath mats, perfumery, and preventing soil erosion on farm bunds.
descriptionKn: ಲಾವಂಚದ ಬೇರುಗಳು ನೀರನ್ನು ತಂಪಾಗಿಸಲು, ಆಯುರ್ವೇದ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸುಗಂಧ ತೈಲಕ್ಕೆ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಮಾರಾಟವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.
descriptionTa: வெட்டிவேர் உடலுக்கு குளிர்ச்சி தரும் பாரம்பரிய மூலிகை. இதன் நறுமண வேர்களுக்கு சர்வதேச சந்தையில் பெரும் மதிப்பு உண்டு.
descriptionTe: వట్టివేరు వేసవిలో దాహార్తిని తీర్చే దివ్య ఔషధం. మట్టి కోతను నివారించడంతో పాటు అత్యధిక లాభాలు అందిస్తుంది.
risks: Hard clay soils make harvesting roots difficult (loose sandy loams are essential)
benefits: Roots sell for ₹100-₹150/kg dry for mats, water filters, and oil distillation
Roots hold soil tightly, preventing soil erosion on bunds and slopes

name: Watermelon
confidenceNote: Premier summer cash crop of riverbeds and drip fields (Kiran / Max / Black Pack).

images.author: (c) Ahmad Fuad Morad, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC-SA)

rainfallMm: Riverbed / drip irrigation with plastic mulch
spacing: 2 m x 0.5 m on silver-black plastic mulch with drip line
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 45:30:45 kg N:P:K (withhold watering 5 days before harvest to maximize sugar brix).
harvestSigns: Tendril at fruit axil dries up completely; ground spot turns creamy yellow; dull thud sound on tapping.
storageAdvice: Store at 12-15°C; holds for 10-14 days without loss of crispness.
description: Watermelon is the #1 short-term summer cash generator. Grown on plastic mulch with drip irrigation, farmers harvest 20+ tonnes in just 80 days for peak summer demand.
descriptionKn: ಕೇವಲ 80 ದಿನದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಕರೆಗೆ 20 ಟನ್ ಇಳುವರಿ ನೀಡಿ, ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಲಾಭ ತರುವ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: 80 நாட்களில் எக்டருக்கு டன் கணக்கில் அறுவடை தரும் மிகச்சிறந்த கோடை பணப்பயிர்.
descriptionTe: కేవలం 80 రోజుల్లో ఎకరానికి రూ. 2 లక్షల వరకు నికర లాభం అందించే అద్భుతమైన వేసవి పంట.
risks: Fusarium wilt in previously infected soil
Downy mildew and fruit cracking if over-irrigated at ripening
benefits: Extremely rapid turnover (75-80 days)
Explosive urban summer juice and fruit stall demand

name: Wheat (Durum / Bread Wheat)
confidenceNote: Standard UAS Dharwad package of practices for North Karnataka black vertisols (DWR-162 / UAS-304).

images.author: (c) jackheijnemans, some rights reserved (CC BY-NC)

rainfallMm: Residual moisture in black soil + 2-3 irrigations
fertilizerSchedule: 30:15:15 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Straw turns golden yellow and grains cannot be broken between fingernails.
storageAdvice: Sun dry to 10% moisture before storing with neem leaves.
description: Winter Rabi wheat is cultivated in the deep black cotton soils of North Karnataka (Belagavi, Dharwad, Bagalkot, Vijayapura) and Northern Telangana.
descriptionKn: ಉತ್ತರ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಕಪ್ಪು ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಚಳಿಗಾಲದ ಹಿಂಗಾರು ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಗೋಧಿ ಉತ್ತಮ ಇಳುವರಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: குளிர்காலத்தில் வளரும் கோதுமை வட கர்நாடக மற்றும் ஆந்திராவின் கரிசல் நிலங்களில் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது.
descriptionTe: శీతాకాలం రబీలో నల్లరేగడి భూముల్లో గోధుమ సాగు లాభదాయకంగా ఉంటుంది.
risks: Stem and leaf rust during mild warm winters
Termites in dry seedbeds
benefits: Excellent price for local samba/durum varieties used for sooji and rava
Valuable nutritive straw
